_comment: Auto-derived from ns/technical.ttl -- Arkivar's own fallback vocabulary for technical facts with no home in Dublin Core, EXIF, or NFO. These are extracted automatically by FIELD_REGISTRY, never hand-entered, so no term_uri override is needed: predicate = namespace_uri + local_name for every term.

terms.label: Size of the file, in bytes.
Manufacturer of the lens used to capture an image, where distinct from the camera manufacturer.
Model name of the lens used to capture an image.
The color space encoding used by an image (e.g. sRGB, Adobe RGB).
The version of the Adobe Digital Negative (DNG) specification a raw image file conforms to.
The pixel color type of a lossless image file (e.g. RGB, RGBA, Grayscale, Indexed).
The compression scheme applied to a file's encoded data.
The software or service that produced a document file, as distinct from the tool used to author its content (see arkivar:creatorTool).
The software application used to author or create the content of a file.
The version of the PDF specification a file conforms to.
The character encoding used by a plain-text or structured-text file (e.g. UTF-8).
The number of bits used to represent each audio sample.
The average bitrate of a compressed audio or video stream.
The software used to encode a compressed audio file.
The number of video frames captured or played back per second.
The compression codec used to encode a file's video stream.
The compression codec used to encode a file's audio stream.
